parts.text: Put on my deep focus electronic coding playlist on Spotify while I review these diffs.
What are the latest breaking announcements from the Python 3.13 release notes on the web right now?
Find a quiet coffee shop with good Wi-Fi near downtown Austin that is open right now.
Check my Google Calendar for today and tell me when my next free focus block is.
Check my unread Gmail messages and tell me if Alex sent an update on the auth service rollout.
Search my Google Drive for the token rotation PRD and tell me what grace window it specifies.
Check the eng-alerts channel on Slack and tell me if the staging canary passed.
Check the GitHub CI status on the latest pull request for auth-svc.
Dispatch a task in plan mode on auth-svc using Claude Code to refactor the Redis session store.
